## Episode Thesis

This is a Norwegian personal-finance podcast from VG/Dine Penger. The host Hallgeir revises his list of about 25 favourite funds and gives his model portfolio: 60% global index, 15% KLP emerging markets multifactor, 10% global small/mid-cap index and 10% Heimdal Utbytte. His main points are low-cost index funds for global exposure, active managers for Norway and the Nordics, broader spread beyond the US and tech-heavy mega-caps, and a view that pharma looks underpriced. Individual stocks come up only as fund holdings or examples, and none gets a direct buy or sell view.
